page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-focused server instance from the c4 family. It features 24 vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, utilizing hyperthreading with 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core. It includes 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 4 bundled drives, with no integrated GPU.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier results in single-threaded gzip compression (36.68 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (15.42 GB/sec), alongside a top-tier Geekbench single-core score of 2321.0. Multi-core performance is rated as strong, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16159.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 27231.53. Memory bandwidth reaches 2024.01 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, while large-block uncached reads and writes perform at 153.52 GB/sec and 56.59 GB/sec, respectively.

The hardware profile is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and local storage-dependent tasks. The presence of 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage combined with 186.0 GB of RAM supports high-throughput database operations, which is reflected in a Passmark database score of 13056.02 and a Redis SET performance of 44.38 million operations per second. Advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) are available, supporting specialized vector and matrix math operations.
